title: Independently audit QQ16 protected-return ownership and tariffs
body:
PR #4790's return-copy saving depends on keeping producer, service and native ownership caches consistent after each physical tape exchange. This adds a separate source-bound audit of that boundary, with an independent explicit inventory oracle and unequal-length tariff checks. No defect was found in the covered successful returns; the existing saving and construction remain credited to their authors.

Only `research/qq16-return-inventory-audit/` is added. It executes the unchanged PR4790 `ReturnProtocol`, original ownership/alias guards, and retained PR4167 transaction with the actual Tape/Meter/transfer/erasure bodies. The five-role fixture covers producer bank/private slots, service bank/private slots and the native output; it is explicitly a small return-boundary model, not the complete caller.

Evidence at `bb3e4d9441cd9a69cc3b59beaf7654534e3f4678`:
- All 120 ownership arrangements and 480 directed transitions pass. A second Euler-tour check executes all 480 transitions on one persistent fixture, preserving unrelated dirty tapes and updating every cached binding.
- All 676 paired cases with old/returned lengths 0–12 and all four return locations confirm the credited saving `(5n+2, 2n, 4n+2)` in reads/writes/unit moves.
- Eleven invalid preconditions reject. Six in-memory omissions of actual cache, rebinding or erasure statements fail at specified semantic boundaries.
- Registered normal/optimized checks, metadata/source pins and exact committed-byte validation pass on Windows, CPython 3.12.0. The official 12-file export passes integrity checking; both direct modes pass with Git absent from PATH and all exported files read-only, with identical receipts and unchanged bytes. Source corruption rejects in both modes.
- Export SHA256: `8efcd7724ad26cadfaf4412a33f938100aae78352ceff47dfa8686034d186d53`.
- [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39895526567) passed at the exact contribution commit above, including onboarding helper tests, bounded package replay and the committed-input immutability check.

Reproduce:
```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-return-inventory-audit
python -I -W error -B research/qq16-return-inventory-audit/verify.py --json
```

**Limits:** the original PR4790 integrated replay was attempted and failed before any return case executed on Windows: retained PR2753 authentication compares Windows `str(relative_path)` names with POSIX inventory strings and raises `no omitted or extra predecessor files`. No frozen source or guard was patched. This audit does not independently reproduce full caller installation, cleanup, native/numerical execution, production geometry, the whole-root census or total D* versus B* cost. Its small structural fixtures supply completed child outputs; those refills are not a child implementation. Finite control remains unpriced. There is no new κ, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. The optional full-history ancestry preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; all declared pins resolve to the contribution's exact direct parent.

Started from current canonical main `cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703`, priority revision 7, and refreshed it unchanged before submission. Picker nonce `3596dd4d3cb801c77cb9849b8b3e895d`; the `joint-query-controller` card is preserved with a declared refinement to this newer protocol's independent audit. Final overlap refresh covered 320 open PRs, 4,030 Discussion records and all 6,603 top-level notes (03:28–03:30 UTC); no competing scoped audit was found within that coverage. Arbitrary closed diffs and unpublished work remain outside it. [Canonical claim and findings](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19136902).

Audited predecessor: [#4790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4790), exact head `38dd6b59d50d346bb34fea02a4ee1ac8d282ebbf`; its adapter blob matches current main. Credit JoyboyBrian for composition; Chris R / Clear1nsight #4166/#4167/#4172/#4177 for the caller, return transaction and tariff; Tekalign for the role-exchange lineage; Jose Manuel for physical machinery; and all QQ16/native predecessors retained in the package. New audit by Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. This is a separate AI audit with shared source/model assumptions, not independent human or formal-kernel review. Apache-2.0.
